🇺🇸 America spends HUNDREDS OF BILLIONS on its military, but a former B-2 pilot says its biggest weakness is RIGHT AT HOME.

I was joined by retired Air Force Brigadier General Robert Spalding, who also served as a senior China strategist for the Joint Chiefs of Staff.

America's shortage of missiles, aircraft or warships isn't his biggest concern.

It's how easily an enemy could cripple the country WITHOUT fighting its military.

Following a drone incursion at US bases in Britain, Spalding warned that the drone warfare revolution in Ukraine has left Western defenses dangerously behind.

And the threat goes far beyond military installations.

Power grids. Water supplies. Communications. Financial systems.

He believes coordinated cyberattacks and drones could bring ordinary American life to a standstill.

So why isn't Washington fixing this?

Spalding argues the Pentagon remains obsessed with expensive weapons designed for wars overseas, while Congress keeps funding them because jobs and contracts depend on it.

America has built an extraordinary military for fighting abroad while leaving its own infrastructure exposed.

We also discussed China's strategy of weakening Western societies without direct war, and Russia's sweeping new demands for NATO to retreat from Eastern Europe.

Spalding doesn't believe NATO will accept Moscow's terms. He expects the Ukraine war to end in a Korean-style ceasefire, with a demilitarized zone rather than a permanent peace treaty.

But his most unsettling prediction concerned America's defenses.

He doubts Washington will seriously overhaul them until the country suffers a major attack.

The U.S. may not need another aircraft carrier nearly as urgently as it needs to keep the lights on.

@robert_spalding

🚨🇺🇸 Who gains from grounding every US flight?

Officials call Friday’s shutdown a telecom outage, and the FBI reportedly sees no cyber attack.

Anthony Aguilar, a retired Army Special Forces officer, sees three suspects: a plain glitch, the FAA’s new AI traffic system misfiring, or a deliberate scare.

He rules out Iran because Tehran wants Trump to walk away, and he points at the calendar.

Israel’s Mossad chief is in Washington pressing for new strikes on Iran, on the same day every US departure was grounded.

Anthony on the motive:

“They have a reason to provoke the United States into doing this.”

So which is easier to believe, a botched update or an ally grounding 10,000 flights?

@WeTheBrandon

🇺🇸 “Was that cool or what?”

Marco Rubio just got completely upstaged by his own daughter. And he LOVED every second of it.

Daniella Rubio, a 3rd-year law student, introduced her father at the Federalist Society's convention in Washington.

She handled the room so confidently that Rubio couldn't resist bragging about her when he took the microphone.

The Secretary of State has faced some pretty intimidating audiences himself.

But this time, he was just a very proud dad.

Writer: Oliver
